escalation.reason: D7 shows the network 'down (not answering)' and D8 shows 100% of its requests failing. clearing logs 'payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=95'.
escalation.ask: Contact the national payment network operator to restore service. Clearing keeps its pending items and will drain them once the network answers. Item 95 is not poison and must not be quarantined.

sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed: the payment journey still fails at clearing because the external payment network is down. Clearing has 152 items waiting, the oldest 73 s, with 0 processed per second.
sbar.background: The pipeline changed max_transfer_minor on payments from 1000000 to 1, so payments rejected transfers with '422 amount exceeds transfer limit'. A reconciliation session held a write lock on the ledger, which crashed clearing, while primary fraud screening timed out (p95 1818 ms against 15 ms) and the payment network stopped answering.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander itself reverted max_transfer_minor to 1000000, ended the reconciliation session holding the ledger lock, restarted clearing, and failed screening over to its standby; all four actions completed. The remaining fault is the network outage: 100% of clearing's calls to the network fail, so the last recovery check at 61 s was not clean.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up the escalation to the national payment network operator and confirm clearing drains its backlog once the network answers. Do not quarantine item 95, which is not poison. Operations should review the payments rejected under the limit of 1 and the 152 delayed clearing items.
